product.olivetti-pcs44-c.summary: The PCS 44/C was the 486SX model in the MicroTower PCS pair.
product.olivetti-pcs44-c.history: Olivetti documented the PCS 44/C alongside the PCS 46/C on the M4-4x service platform. The University of Granada holds a specimen it dates to after 1993.
product.olivetti-pcs44-c.architecture: The board integrated video and a game port. The guide identifies BA2033 and BA2036, CL-GD5428 and /S BIOS revisions for a single serial port.
product.olivetti-pcs44-c.verified: BluMach’s pcs44c identifier loads V032004G.25 at E0000h and selects OTI-077. Its correspondence with the documented boards remains pending.
product.olivetti-pcs44-c.limitations: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
product.olivetti-pcs44-c.guide: Olivetti, Pocket Service Guide, vol. II, §2.
product.olivetti-pcs44-c.museum: Universidad de Granada, Ordenador Olivetti PCS 44/C, CPS00003.00.00.
